text: {"memo": "COCA COLA CO (KO) delivered FY2024 revenue of $47.06\u202fbillion, up from $45.75\u202fbillion in FY2023, representing roughly a 5% year\u2011over\u2011year increase. Operating income slipped to $9.99\u202fbillion in FY2024 from $11.31\u202fbillion a year earlier, while net income held steady at $10.63\u202fbillion versus $10.71\u202fbillion in FY2023. Diluted EPS was $2.46 in FY2024, marginally below the $2.47 recorded in FY2023. Operating cash flow weakened to $6.80\u202fbillion in FY2024 from $11.60\u202fbillion in FY2023. The margin compression in operating income suggests cost pressures, yet the company maintained solid profitability with an operating margin around 21% in FY2024. Liquidity remains strong with ample cash generation. The company’s strong cash generation supports dividend payments and share buybacks, reinforcing its defensive profile. Despite the slight dip in operating income, the firm\u2019s brand portfolio remains resilient, driving consistent consumer demand. Investor focus should remain on the balance sheet strength and the ability to navigate inflationary pressures. Overall, KO shows steady top\u2011line growth but faces margin headwinds. View: Hold."}
